activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Mara: kicking off project atlas invoices module. You own a TypeScript Node service that renders and emails monthly invoices. Start small, we will evolve the invoice-api contract over many weeks.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text:
invoice-api v1:
POST /invoices accepts {customerId, lines:[{desc, qty, unit_cents}], due_at}.
Returns 201 {id, number, subtotal_cents, tax_cents, total_cents, due_at}.
GET /invoices/{id} returns the invoice with lines and totals.
GET /invoices lists with ?offset=0&limit=20, returns {invoices, offset, limit}.
POST /invoices/{id}/send emails the rendered PDF to the customer.
Money fields use integer cents; dates are ISO strings.
Invoice numbers come from the server allocator.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: PDF renderer is pdfkit 0.15 with template invoices/templates/default.hbs, A4 output, Helvetica embedded. Render via renderInvoicePdf(invoice) synchronously.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: invoice numbers use format INV-YYYY-#### (e.g., INV-2026-0007), sequential per year, stored in invoices.number.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: tax rounding uses floor per line via floorTaxCents(lineCents, rateBps), always rounds down to the cent.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: email delivery uses nodemailer 6 SMTP relay smtp.internal:587 with sendInvoiceEmail() and fixed retry 3 attempts 1s apart via sendWithRetry().

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: money is integer cents in fields named *_cents (subtotal_cents, tax_cents, total_cents); all arithmetic uses addCents()/mulCentsBps() helpers, never floats.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: all dates are ISO 8601 UTC strings (e.g., 2026-02-03T14:00:00.000Z) in issued_at, due_at, paid_at; parsed with parseInvoiceDate().

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: invoice numbers come only from allocateInvoiceNumber() helper backed by invoices_seq; never hand-format numbers.

tasks.prompt: Add support for mid-cycle plan changes with prorated adjustments on the next billing document.

requirements.check: Prorated adjustments compute entirely with addCents()/mulCentsBps() over integer *_cents fields, no floating-point arithmetic.
All stored and returned amounts use integer *_cents fields with addCents()/mulCentsBps() helpers, never floats.
New path follows invoice-api v3: lines carry tax_cents, totals in subtotal_cents/tax_cents/total_cents, numbers only from allocateInvoiceNumber(), dates ISO 8601 UTC.

tasks.prompt: Build a nightly run that nudges accounts with late balances and records when each nudge went out. It should only operate for pilot workspaces during rollout.

requirements.check: Reminder mails queue to invoice_outbox in-txn and drain with pollInvoiceOutbox() after commit; never call sendInvoiceEmail() pre-commit.
All timestamps are ISO 8601 UTC strings in issued_at/due_at/paid_at style fields, parsed with parseInvoiceDate().
Rollout gating reads through flags.get('invoices.xxx') with default false; no direct process.env reads.

tasks.prompt: Refresh the buyer details section and itemized charges area in the downloadable billing file to match the new brand layout.

requirements.check: Buyer block renders customer.address only via escapeHtml() or renderAddressSafe(); no raw ${customer.address} interpolation.
Output is produced via renderInvoicePdfAsync() with pdf-lib 1.17 and invoices/templates/vector.hbs; no pdfkit/puppeteer paths.
File and API include v3 per-line tax_cents breakdown with subtotal_cents/tax_cents/total_cents in *_cents.

tasks.prompt: Add a goodwill adjustment flow for settled billing documents, including levy calculations on the adjustment.

requirements.check: Lifecycle moves only via setInvoiceStatus() validated against allowedInvoiceTransitions; never assign .status directly.
Levy uses half-up on invoice total via roundTaxCents(totalCents, rateBps); no floorTaxCents()/roundHalfUpPerLine() per-line path.
Adjustment follows invoice-api v3 credit-notes: POST /invoices/{id}/credit-notes with {amount_cents, reason} creates CN- note, status among draft|sent|paid|credited.

tasks.prompt: Add bulk onboarding that creates many billing documents at once and notifies each buyer.

requirements.check: Bulk creation math uses addCents()/mulCentsBps() over integer *_cents, no floating-point arithmetic.
Per-buyer notifications queue to invoice_outbox and drain with pollInvoiceOutbox() after commit; no pre-commit sendInvoiceEmail().
Stored amounts are integer *_cents via addCents()/mulCentsBps(), never floats.

tasks.prompt: Build a payment reminder note for late accounts, gated for pilot workspaces, showing buyer location details.

requirements.check: Reminder path queues to invoice_outbox and drains with pollInvoiceOutbox() after commit; never call sendInvoiceEmail() pre-commit.
Location block uses escapeHtml() or renderAddressSafe(); no raw ${customer.address} interpolation.
Pilot gating via flags.get('invoices.xxx') default false; no process.env reads.

tasks.prompt: Add a reimbursement path for settled billing documents that issues a new reference code and moves the lifecycle forward.

requirements.check: Reimbursement math uses addCents()/mulCentsBps() over integer *_cents, no floating-point arithmetic.
Moves use setInvoiceStatus() with allowedInvoiceTransitions; no direct .status assignment.
Reference codes come only from allocateInvoiceNumber() backed by invoices_seq; never hand-format.

tasks.prompt: Make an operations dashboard showing past billing documents with buyer location details and timing info, paged for large volumes.

requirements.check: Dashboard buyer details use escapeHtml()/renderAddressSafe(); no raw ${customer.address}.
Timing fields are ISO 8601 UTC strings in issued_at/due_at/paid_at, parsed with parseInvoiceDate().
Implementation stays on TypeScript Node 20 Express 4 pg 8 service with jest 29 snapshots in tests/invoices/.
List follows invoice-api v3: GET /invoices with ?offset=0&limit=20 returns {invoices, offset, limit} with *_cents totals.
